prompt: Implement the function slugify(text) in slug.py; the file already exists with a stub. Rules: (1) the result is lowercase; (2) accented Latin letters become their unaccented base letter (é becomes e, ü becomes u); (3) every run of characters other than a-z and 0-9 becomes a single hyphen; (4) the result has no leading or trailing hyphen; (5) if nothing is left, return the empty string. Keep the function name and do not add a main program.
